analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 후 소폭 반등 중이나 여전히 40선 하회. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간. ADX 26.8로 뚜렷한 추세는 형성되었으나 +DI(15.9) 대비 -DI(33.6)가 우위인 약세 흐름. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 2.29로 급증했으나 가격은 스윙 저항선 $0.08 돌파 실패. 뚜렷한 방향성 부재로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive trading day. RSI is slightly rebounding after entering oversold territory but remains below 40. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays in negative territory. ADX at 26.8 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (33.6) is dominant over +DI (15.9), suggesting a weak trend. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 2.29 (surge), but price failed to break the swing resistance at $0.08. No clear directionality observed, hence the continued wait-and-see stance.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 RSI 42.0으로 중립 구간이나, 일봉 RSI 35.6 과매도 구간 진입으로 충돌
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 42.0 is neutral, conflicting with the daily RSI at 35.6 entering oversold territory.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0004→-0.0001): 개선 중이나 여전히 음수, 추세 전환 신호 미약

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.08) vs SMA5/20 ($0.08/$0.08) - short-term trend neutral, below SMA50 ($0.09)
· Below SMA100 ($0.08) and SMA200 ($0.09) - medium to long-term trend weak
· 52-week position (6.1%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.5→35.6) - slight recovery after entering oversold territory, weak directional momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0004→-0.0001) - improving but still negative, weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (midline $0.08) - band width narrowed to 13.64%, lacking directionality
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line ($0.07) - based on Pivot S1 and 5-day/20-day lows
· Swing resistance line ($0.08) - aligned with Pivot R1 and 5-day/20-day highs, potential for short-term upside breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) - no trend reversal signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.29x) - movement is gaining momentum, increasing reliability
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) - no clear directionality, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 $0.08은 스윙 저항선이자 볼린저밴드 중단에 위치하며, 5일/20일 고가와 일치. 뚜렷한 패턴 형성 없이 횡보 구간 지속.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price of $0.08 is at the swing resistance and Bollinger Band midline, aligning with the 5-day/20-day highs. The sideways trend continues without a clear pattern formation.

analysis.continuity: 직전 2거래일 연속 관망 유지. 금일 RSI 과매도 구간 진입 및 MACD 히스토그램 개선으로 매수 점수 소폭 상승했으나, ADX 추세 미약 및 스윙 저항선 돌파 실패로 3거래일 연속 관망 판독 지속.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see approach has been maintained for the past two consecutive trading days. Today, the RSI entering oversold territory and MACD histogram improvement slightly increased the buy score, but the weak ADX trend and failure to break swing resistance led to a third consecutive session of wait-and-see assessment.
